title: Automatic bioinformatic software named entity recognition from literature
abstract: arXiv:2608.19201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bioinformatics software and databases are essential components of modern life science research, yet their mentions in the scientific literature are often inconsistent and difficult to systematically identify at scale. The lack of a comprehensive and up-to-date catalog of bioinformatics resources hinders efforts toward automated biomedical knowledge extraction and streamlined data analysis. Here we present SNAIL, a hybrid named entity recognition framework designed to automatically identify bioinformatics software and database (SW/DB) names from biomedical texts. SNAIL integrates complementary lexical and semantic modeling strategies. The lexical component captures orthographic patterns and contextual cues characteristic of SW/DB names, while the semantic component leverages contextual embeddings generated by transformer-based language models such as SciBERT, combined with an explicit token-masking strategy to enhance entity-focused rep

translated_title: 文献中生物信息学软件命名实体的自动识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19201v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：生物信息学软件和数据库是现代生命科学研究的重要组成部分，然而它们在科学文献中的提及往往不一致，难以大规模系统识别。缺乏全面且最新的生物信息学资源目录阻碍了自动化生物医学知识提取和简化数据分析的努力。在此，我们提出了SNAIL，一种混合命名实体识别框架，旨在自动从生物医学文本中识别生物信息学软件和数据库（SW/DB）名称。SNAIL整合了互补的词汇和语义建模策略。词汇组件捕获SW/DB名称特有的正字法模式和上下文线索，而语义组件利用基于Transformer的语言模型（如SciBERT）生成的上下文嵌入，并结合显式令牌掩蔽策略以增强实体聚焦表示。
tldr: 本文提出了SNAIL，一种混合命名实体识别框架，通过结合词汇和语义策略自动识别生物医学文献中的软件和数据库名称，解决了生物信息学资源目录不完整的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents SNAIL, a hybrid named entity recognition framework that combines lexical and semantic strategies to automatically identify bioinformatics software and database names from biomedical literature, addressing the issue of incomplete resource catalogs.
